sources.prompt: Create a beautiful detailed GAME ART CONCEPT for KNIGHT'S WISH: THE BRICKWORKS QUARTER, a playable medieval magical village construction and production district. Use the attached building atlas only as the exact art-direction guide: premium hand-painted PIXEL ART, deliberate crisp square clusters and stepped outlines, slate blue roofs, warm limestone, dark oak beams, burgundy banners, golden lights, elevated orthographic3/4 camera looking at front and right sides. This should be one coherent lush inhabited game-world scene, landscape16:10 composition, NOT a sprite sheet or UI mockup. The geography and production flow must be clearly understandable. At left, a small terraced ochre CLAY PIT with pick marks, clay baskets and two brickmakers digging; beside it, open clay mixing tubs and organized rows of unfired bricks drying on wooden racks. In the middle, a circular red-brick KILN with a low bright orange fire arch, tall stepped brick chimney, small controllable flue, neat stacks of fired terracotta bricks and a wheelbarrow. At right, a MASONRY YARD with a teal cloth canopy, limestone blocks, heavy cutting bench, hanging hoist, chisels and stone dust. Above it, a COTTAGE UNDER CONSTRUCTION: precise low brick walls, exposed dark oak upper frame and roof trusses, scaffolding with planks, ladders and a little pulley; one mason actively laying bricks. Along the rear, a clean shallow stream drives a handsome WATERWHEEL attached to a small slate-roof workshop; visible wooden shafts and brass cog wheels carry mechanical power to a nearby clay brick press. A subtle teal rune crystal reinforces the workshop's axle, showing restrained useful magic, not giant spell effects. At front, MODULAR BRICK CASTLE WALLS demonstrate the building process in-place: a stone foundation section, a half-built brick section with scaffold, a completed crenellated wall, and a finished brick-and-limestone arched gate with burgundy banner. Cobblestone lanes and sensible loading yards connect all work areas; several small believable workers carry crates, push handcarts or move stone. Warm late-afternoon light from upper left, shaded green grass, fern and oak edges, a few flowers and wooden fences. Make workshop silhouettes distinct and construction stages obvious. The world should invite the player to build and expand it. Keep the compact modular footprints and material handling legible, with breathing space between buildings. No text, no labels, no UI panels, no arrows, no grids, no modern machinery, no smooth3D-render look. Rich professional fantasy strategy art, not a toy diorama or icon board.
